findings.summary: §1.1 masks the timeout by bumping node_timeout 30→300, which spec line 109 explicitly forbids (⛔ 不得靠调大 node_timeout 或 AGENT_RESULT_TIMEOUT_MS 掩盖). GT-15/GT-16 and §1.1 (lines 103-112) require identifying where the 30s is spent on a seed board and eliminating that cause so a tick runs well below node_timeout on its own merits. The implementation adds PhaseTimings instrumentation and a §1.2 early-exit for exited-without-result runs (both good), but then bumps node_timeout 10x to 300s instead of eliminating the slow step. The workflow.yaml comment (lines 10-17) justifies 300s as a sufficient lower bound, but that is precisely the forbidden masking approach — the spec requires the seed-board tick to be genuinely fast, not given a larger kill window. node_timeout:300 also exceeds wall_clock:60 in the same limits line, making the configuration internally contradictory.

§1.1 discriminating test (criterion 2) does not discriminate the actual node_timeout change and references a stale engine bound. The test asserts totalMs < 15000 with comment 'node_timeout: 30 的一半', but the actual node_timeout is now 300 (half = 150000ms). Reverting node_timeout 300→30 would not make this test red because the mocked test environment runs in milliseconds regardless of the engine limit. Per spec line 134: ⛔ 断言必须针对引擎真正生效的那个上界. The test discriminates PhaseTimings instrumentation removal but not the §1.1 fix (node_timeout adjustment) itself, which is the '判别性没落地' rejection pattern the spec calls out at line 179.
